subject: Where Logic keeps the strings for Install and Learn by Key Label, and whether the repository's own resolver can see them
question: Is a string that AXStringResolver.resolve cannot resolve therefore uncitable?

reverify.cost: ~20s; reads the app bundle, launches nothing

method: Asked the extractor rather than the resolver. `resolve` reads StringsIndex; the absence sets are built from extract_strings. Compared the two populations by (unit, key), then looked up two strings that resolve to None.

observations.what: (unit, key) pairs extract_strings yields for ko
(unit, key) pairs StringsIndex holds for ko
pairs in the corpus that the resolver cannot see
places 설치 is a whole value in ko
places 키 레이블로 학습 is a whole value in ko
policy literals classified `nowhere` re-tested against the full corpus
of those found to be present after all

conclusion: No. A string the resolver cannot resolve may still be a whole value in the corpus, and both strings checked here are. The resolver reads 10395 of the 60048 pairs the extractor yields for ko, so 49653 are outside it -- among them the IB-keyed tables where Logic keeps 설치 and 키 레이블로 학습. `is_absent` reads the full corpus and correctly refuses an absence claim for either, so an author who takes `resolve -> None` as uncitable has no path in either direction. The gap is confined to that one function: re-testing all 101 literals classified `nowhere` found 0 present, so the classification, the absence proofs and the AXHelp result are unaffected.
limits: One locale. The 60048/10395 split was measured for ko only; the other locales were not counted.
One direction of the pair. Whether StringsIndex holds anything the extractor does NOT yield was not measured.
This says nothing about whether the resolver SHOULD read more. A content-database hit is noise when reversing a live AXHelp reading, which is what that table is for.
The two strings were chosen because two open pull requests need them, not by sampling. How many other labels sit in the same gap is unmeasured.

canon.used_for: the citation #891 needs for the Install button, and the first worked example of a string `resolve` answers None for
the citation #882 needs, and the second example -- it is the string that made #895 visible, because the English is in a nib and only the translated locales get a .strings overlay
